_comment: Single source of truth for ALL tunable settings. Edit here, then run ./tools/jump gen (flash does it automatically). The simulator reads this file directly; the firmware gets it via the generated firmware/include/params.gen.h.

shared._comment: Constants that exist in MORE THAN ONE LANGUAGE and must not drift (audit F-18, 2026-08-22). Generated into firmware/include/params.gen.h and garmin/jumpfield/source/Params.gen.mc. Detector thresholds are deliberately NOT here: the watch's MAX_HEIGHT_M/MAX_AIRTIME_S are impossibility bounds for its corruption gate, not the detector's tuned thresholds, and generating one from the other would couple two things that are supposed to differ.
